definitions.tp: original L2-normalized attention-pooled descriptor cosine with anchor prototype
definitions.local: TP-attention weighted mean of per-target-patch top-r foreground-anchor-token similarities
definitions.calibration: median/MAD separately per anchor/component on original train RGB, excluding the anchor itself; freeze before route evaluation
definitions.transition_calibration: global median/MAD of off-diagonal unordered train/train patch_mean cosine pairs; dimensionless transitions for both Joint variants
definitions.knn_proposal: original patch_mean nearest-neighbor proposal ordering, with new conditional score as tie-break; joint score enters anchor and full beam path objective
definitions.path_objective: lexicographic max(bottleneck, mean) over conditional node scores and consecutive transition scores
definitions.router: historical ridge=1.0, fit independently per family on validation; no mode bits, no student
definitions.validation: 5-fold target-level OOF, seed 2026, diagnostic; both Joint variants proceed to test by user request
definitions.test: 100 fixed test targets, fit final Router on all original 100 validation targets before test inference, no confidence filtering or test tuning

numerical_precision: Historical model/TP/PC mixed-precision execution unchanged; SAM3 tracking predictor enters process-wide bfloat16 autocast and model_builder enables TF32. New local correspondence/attention head explicitly float64; scalar storage float32. Initial mixed-precision reference error corrected before any propagation; not attributed solely to TF32.
